The '''Spacesuit''' is what allows [[The protagonist|the protagonist]] not to die in space, if they remember to put it on.<!-- I'd normally change this to have a more clinical tone but this sentence felt so fitting for outer wilds that it can stay. -->

==O2==
The suit carries a small oxygen tank, allowing for about six minutes <!--TODO check that--> of breathing before [[death]].

Oxygen will also be used as a weak propellant when the main fuel tank is empty. Using enough oxygen in this manner will grant the [[achievements#Cutting it Close|Cutting it Close achievement]].

==Appearance==
The suit has a unique appearance. It has a poncho looking scarf around the neck as well as a padded glove pair, Also including a pair of brown boots and patched up clothing with a sort of kettle shaped helmet. 

<!--TODO : actual description, O2 reserves, jetpack, listing of parts-->== Jetpack ==
The suit carries a small jetpack, complete with miniature multi-directional thrusters and a small fuel tank. <!-- TODO check how long jetpack lasts -->
